notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Devastating Onslaught
description:
Cast Devastating Onslaught by paying {2}{R}, targeting an artifact or creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Devastating Onslaught, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Devastating Onslaught, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
